DeconstructCamera.description: Split a Camera into its name, location, target, lens and up direction.

AnimateObjectsMove.name: Animate Objects Move
AnimateObjectsMove.description: Move one object between two recorded positions. Click set A and set B to record where it starts and ends, then drive t from 0 to 1. Turn on apply to move the Rhino object itself instead of a preview; reset releases it.

ColorPreview.description: Preview geometry in the viewport with a given color. Pair it with Color Opacity to fade geometry in or out.

DeconstructClippingPlane.description: Read the plane and normal of a Rhino clipping plane from its id.
